summary: Click Holdings Ltd., a Hong Kong-based foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting its Q3 FY2025/26 operating performance via a press release. The filing discloses a 73% year-over-year revenue increase to HK$38 million, driven by growth in nursing and logistics segments under the Care U brand. There are no special-situation corporate events — no merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or capital return announcement. The filing is a routine earnings update with forward-looking statements about potential strategic expansion into the Greater Bay Area. This is an ordinary operating update, not a special-situation filing. No deal terms are present.
